newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 7.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunkers up on higher cargo prices and good demand, traders said. A major said he sold 10,000 tonnes of 180-cst and 380-cst supplies in several at $125 and $120 per tonne respectively. Traders said despite higher prices, shipowners were covering requirements as they projected higher prices later this week. MDO and gasoil were up on firm cargo prices.
